description:
[modeled] How the liquidation map evolved over time: grid[t][b] is the estimated USD of
    leveraged positions with their liquidation price in price bin b at time cols[t] (ms),
    bins[b] is the bin's centre price (240 bins fitted to the traded range) and price[t] is
    the close. A level disappears once price trades through it. Use get_liquidation_map for
    the current picture only (smaller answer, split by leverage and exchange); use this one
    to see when a cluster formed and whether it is still there. The answer is large
    (about 35,000 numbers). symbol: BASEUSDT. exchange: all | binance | bybit | okx.
    range: 12h | 1d | 3d | 7d.
name: get_liquidation_heatmap
